name: access-chip
title: Access Chip
description: How far one record reaches as one focusable chip: the space tile and name, a lock and Only invited, My space, or a space the viewer cannot see (someone's My space, a private space) — with a globe when published and the full sentence in a tooltip. Clicking opens Share.

meta.whenToUse: A record header that shows who can open the record and opens Share.
meta.whenNotToUse: Changing access inline (PermissionMenu) or listing people (AvatarStack).
